correction: An earlier commit in this lane (b2abed4d) recorded that this harness FAILED 0/10 on raid2 and attributed it to a race in selectArena. THAT DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG and is corrected here. The harness hardcodes `const PORT = 41931` and spawns its preview with --strictPort. On this machine another lane's worktree (aa-claude-farcrysis) already held 41931 with an orphaned vite preview, so the spawn failed and the script drove THAT WORKTREE'S BUILD - a build with no raid2 in it - which is why every camera came back 'authored camera missing'. Two of the probes used to diagnose it were themselves pointed at other lanes' orphaned servers on 41932 (aa-claude-nuketown) and 41933 (aa-claude-lighting), which is why they appeared to show a selection race. Re-run against this worktree's own preview on a free port (--url http://127.0.0.1:41941), the UNMODIFIED sanctioned harness reports OK 10/10. There is no race and no raid2 defect.
harnessFinding: Still a real and reportable defect in the shared harness, just a different one: it has no port-collision detection. With several lane worktrees live on one machine it will silently measure another lane's build and report a confident FAIL against your arena. The exact patch is in the lane report; the file belongs to another lane and was not edited here.
